title: A bridged house reply queued through the atomic intent is emailed once, not a second time by the conversation batch flush

source.ref: Meta scan eight (2026-10-12), Space email cluster review of #3364 (EMAIL-002).

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: enqueue_conversation_email_intent (migration 20270346007600) writes an outbound comms_messages row with delivery_status 'queued' AND its own notification_queue email job. flushConversationBatches read every queued outbound row with no other filter, so the five-minute conversation-batches cron would send the same reply again from the default house address and mark it sent. Behind EMAIL_ATOMIC_BRIDGE_ENABLED, which is off today, so no member has been double-emailed yet; turning the switch on would have done it on every reply. THE FIX: the flush skips rows whose metadata carries delivery_intent_id, with a test in outbound-batch-claim.test.ts that fails without it.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('lib/comms/outbound-batch.ts','utf8');if(!/\.is\('metadata->>delivery_intent_id', null\)/.test(s)){console.error('SCAN-816: the batch flush re-sends rows the atomic intent RPC already queued');process.exit(1)}"
